cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a present-day indoor bowling alley during a quiet practice hour — testing her legendary precision on a leisure game; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a private present-day sleeper-train compartment beside a large window — waking from a nap and reaching to close the window blind as the train enters a station; a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — sitting on the ground; a terrace on a castle wall overlooking the valley — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a backstage dressing room with a bulb-lit mirror — holds a small bouquet at chest height; her tower bedchamber in a stone castle — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds her keepsake at chest height
